name: diag_look_census_plan_01
command:
import pathlib,json,hashlib,importlib.util
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
r=pathlib.Path.cwd(); inv=r/'logs/review/diag_current_look_inventory_01/current_look_inventory.json'
assert sha_file(inv)=='8e2d3b4ac0e15015c0ba14831d904b26baa6bf43afac558bd12ce90423d2e189'
d=json.loads(inv.read_text());rows=d['current_standard']['pairs'];assert len(rows)==17
for n in ('t02_stay_source_cpu_01','diag_t02_stay_source_ready_01'):
 test,_=audited_result(r/'results'/f'{n}.json');assert test['_meta']['exit_code']==0
e,er=audited_result(r/'results/smoke_e2e_look_views_01_retry2.json')
first=e['metrics']['exports'][0];assert e['_meta']['exit_code']==1 and e['metrics']['cleanup_errors']==[] and e['metrics']['black_frame_detected'] is False
assert first['pair_id']=='floorplan203_00002' and first['rejection_reasons']==['non_anchor_divergent'] and first['cleanup_errors']==[]
sp=first['source_package'];assert sha_file(pathlib.Path(sp['file']))==sp['sha256'];package=json.loads(pathlib.Path(sp['file']).read_text())
existing=next(x for x in rows if x['pair_id']=='floorplan203_00002')
assert package['source_provenance']['pair']==existing['pair_reference']
remaining=[x for x in rows if x is not existing]
old=[x for x in remaining if x['checkpoint']['file']=='results/t01v2_checkpoint_flip_geometry_01.json']
new=[x for x in remaining if x['checkpoint']['file']=='results/t01v2_checkpoint_stay_visible_01.json']
assert len(old)==13 and [x['pair_id'] for x in new]==['floorplan203_00104','floorplan203_00114','floorplan203_00116']
groups=[]
for suffix,subset,wall,timeout in [('a01',old[:7],2700,2640),('b01',old[7:],2340,2280),('c01',new,1320,1260)]:
 source=subset[0]['checkpoint']['file'];assert all(x['checkpoint']['file']==source for x in subset)
 groups.append({'outer_name':'pilot_pairs_v2_look_table_'+suffix,'inner_name':'t02_look_table_'+suffix,'source':source,'pair_ids':[x['pair_id'] for x in subset],'pair_references':[x['pair_reference'] for x in subset],'gpus':1,'wall_seconds':wall,'timeout_seconds':timeout,'pair_timeout_seconds':300,'gate_timeout_seconds':180,'budget_group':'T01v2'})
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase',r/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py');phase=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(phase);b=phase.budget_state(r)
requested=sum(g['wall_seconds']/3600 for g in groups)
assert b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['T01v2']+requested<=16 and b['accounted_or_reserved_total']+requested<=60
plan={'scope':'current60degree_fixed_labels_independently_constructed_Look_pairs; diagnose only, unchanged D4 classifier; no cache/training authorization','inventory':{'file':str(inv.relative_to(r)),'sha256':sha_file(inv)},'unique_denominator':17,'existing_conclusive_failure':{'entry':existing,'export_result':er,'report':first,'definition':'any observed Look D4 state with anchor_pixels0,0 and maxRGBdiff>3 suffices to trigger; reuse actual first failure, do not rerender or erase it'},'groups':groups,'reserved_gpu_hours_upper_bound':requested,'budget_before':b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],'classification':'triggered_non_anchor_divergent; completed_without_this_trigger; unknown_timeout_or_other_error; count no unknown as pass','historical12_unfixed_labels':'listed separately in inventory; not current standard','budget_note':'per-pair300s bound follows prior bounded exporter; request includes source authentication/gate/finalization, actual end accounting replaces ceilings'}
out=r/'logs/review/diag_look_census_plan_01';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
with (out/'census_plan.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(plan,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True);f.write('\n')
print('LOOK_CENSUS_PLAN: '+json.dumps(plan,sort_keys=True))
p=r/'STATUS.md';p.write_text(p.read_text()+'\n### Human-requested unchanged-rule Look export census\n\nThe frozen current inventory contains17 unique60degree fixed-label LookFlip pairs and0 LookStay. The earlier12 unfixed-label Stay records remain a separate historical cohort. The already measured floorplan203_00002 rejection is reused as one conclusive trigger; the other16 will run original T02 D4 export in fixed7/6/3-pair groups, each on oneGPU, keeping failures and unknowns separate. The existing exporter continues after ordinary rejections and retains its original black/cleanup/deadline stops. No threshold, classifier, cache requirement or training gate changes. Requested ceilings total '+str(requested)+' GPUh inside the16 T01v2 subbudget; exact plan logs/review/diag_look_census_plan_01/census_plan.json.\n')
